name: New Mexico
notes: New Mexico supports digital ID in Apple Wallet and Google Wallet. Samsung Wallet is not currently supported.

wallets.name: Apple Wallet
steps: Open the Wallet app on your iPhone (iOS 15.4 or later required).
Tap the + button and choose 'Driver's License or State ID'.
Select New Mexico from the state list.
Scan the front and back of your New Mexico driver's license or ID card.
Complete the face and motion scan to verify your identity.
Your request is sent to the New Mexico MVD. You'll receive a notification once approved — usually within a few minutes.

wallets.name: Google Wallet
steps: Open Google Wallet on your Android device.
Tap + and select 'ID documents', then 'Driver's license or state ID'.
Scan the front and back of your New Mexico driver's license or ID.
Complete the selfie step to verify your identity.
The New Mexico MVD will process and approve your digital ID within a few minutes.
